changelog: Redesigned IDA Pro UI with dark glassmorphism aesthetics and IDA-matching color palette (#3a9fd5 accent)
Enhanced ContextBar with interactive jump-to-address/function actions, active LED status indicator, and dynamic token usage warning colors
Redesigned input area layout with top action toolbar, quick skill chips (/vuln-audit, /memory-corruption, etc.), and glow focus styling
Smart idapyswitch auto-configuration selecting system python3 matching version
Proactive site-packages path injection for embedded IDA Python interpreter to recognize system pip packages (anthropic, etc.)
Improved auto-update engine with git pull strategy support for git-managed plugin installations
Fixed white background container fill artifact on Linux and macOS UI panels
Interactive CLI shell interface with Ctrl+O raw-mode and streaming UI
Docker containerization support with multi-platform images
SSH remote execution and file transfer tools
Shell command safety checks with configurable auto-approve limits
LM Studio provider support for local LLM integration
Added container-escape, crypto-vuln, iot-vuln, scada-vuln, vm-escape, web3-vuln security skills
